newsitem.title: USA: New York girl shot in head by mother's gun.
newsitem.headline: New York girl shot in head by mother's gun.

text.p: A 4-year-old girl who shot herself accidentally with her police officer mother's gun was in critical condition on Friday with head wounds.
The child was wounded on Thursday afternoon at her home in the New York City borough of Queens by a bullet that entered above her right eye and travelled through the top of her skull, police said.
"She was shot in the head by a firearm owned by her mother, a housing bureau officer," police spokeswoman Sonia Oquenda said. "It was an accidentally self-inflicted injury."
Neighbours said the mother was distraught. Police said that because the shooting appeared to have been accidental, the mother probably would not be charged.

Police said the mother, who was not identified, was sitting with her daughter at a table where she had put down her .38 calibre revolver. The mother turned to do something else and the girl apparently picked up the gun, police said.
The gun either discharged as the girl handled it or she pulled the trigger, they said.
